name: Bigelow sagebrush
desc: Bigelow sagebrush (Artemisia bigelovii): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 2 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Artemisia bigelovii is a North American species of sagebrush known by the common name Bigelow sagebrush or flat sagebrush. It grows in the deserts of the southwestern United States.
